sources: Oblivion (6-star Arts Unit), skill 3 "Twilight: Humiliation": "When the wielder casts an ultimate, the wielder gains Arts DMG Dealt +{spell_dmg_up} for {duration}s. When the wielder casts a combo skill, the wielder gains Arts DMG Dealt +{spell_dmg_up2} for {duration2}s. The two effects apply separately and do not stack with themselves." SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_funnel_0009: spell_dmg_up 0.24 (L1) to 0.672 (L9), spell_dmg_up2 0.12 to 0.336, duration and duration2 15.

rmxlinux Json/SkillData sk_wpn_funnel_0009 passiveEventActions: abilityEvent 30 (the wielder casts a skill) + CheckSkillType [7] (ultimate) → buff_wpn_funnel_0009_magic_up_ult (spell_dmg_up, duration); CheckSkillType [6] (combo) → buff_wpn_funnel_0009_magic_up_combo (spell_dmg_up2, duration2). Both on the wielder, attributes 51–54 (Heat / Electric / Cryo / Nature DMG) formulaItem 5, stackingType 4 (one instance; a re-cast refreshes it).

The Intellect, Arts DMG and crit rate + crit_up lines (cardAttributeModifier) are in the stat panel; toggleBuffs names buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01, which has no BuffData file (inert). Works for any Arts wielder with an Arts combo or ultimate (Ardelia's are both Nature). docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0025_ardelia.md W6–W7.

triggers.note: At the cast (abilityEvent 30), so every hit of that ultimate has it.
At the combo's cast; separate from the ultimate's buff, so the two add.
